Messages.Author: Geoffrey J. Schaller
Messages.Body:

> >Has anyone else noticed that DS cards look MUCH cooler than the V:TES

>

> I noticed this tonight infact when I put Raven next to Chandler. I'm
> curious why the line is not on the DS vampires. A friend suggested that
> perhaps the expansion was made before the V:TES cards were, and if so why
> did they wait so long to release the expansion? Just something to
> consider. I doubt they just forgot to put the line around the vampires,
> and I don't see them dropping them so soon after V:TES was released unless
> there was complaints. I think I prefer them without the line because the
> Jyhad border has a 3-D look to it. I'm just curious why the red line was
> not used in DS.

The "Red Line" is the "White Border" from Magic, but since a white border would REALLY
look bad on a Vampire game, they used the Red Line. Cards of an "Unlimited" or "Revised"
print will have the Red Line, whereas cards of a "Limited Print" (such as Jhyad, or DS)
will not. This way, if DS ever gets reprinted or added to a new revision of V:TES, it
will have the Red Line to distinguish it from the rest. (The symbol is not enough - note
that the Chronicles cards from M:tG are white bordered and "unlimited," but still have
the symbols.)
